description: Rezones land near Traeger Manor and Terrace to R2.
R2 district allows one to four-unit dwellings.

chips.text: Property owners within 150 meters of the site were notified.
No public correspondence or speakers addressed Council on this matter.

description: Rezones 400 block Cowessess Terrace from R2 to R1B.
Corrects an oversight for specific low-density housing.
Allows homes to front an adjacent municipal reserve.

chips.text: Councillor Donauer commended administration for handling the rezoning oversight.
Dream Asset Management Corporation was not charged application fees.

description: Changes zoning from FUD to R1A, R1B, R2, FUD(H) districts.
Permits one-to-four unit residential development in Brighton neighbourhood.
Applies zoning to municipal reserve and wetland complex lands.

chips.text: Two individuals contacted administration about wetland and park zoning.
Wetland will be dedicated as municipal utility parcel, parks as municipal reserve.

description: Sells 1.2 acres of Nutana Kiwanis Park North to Elmwood Residences.
Funds Elmwood Community Hub-Homebase Project, including 42 affordable housing units.
Requires options to offset parkland loss in Nutana sector.

chips.text: Councillor Dubois praised the project's inclusivity and long-term community benefits.
Community garden collective will have their garden relocated with no loss of space.
Administration noted precedent for selling parkland for significant community benefits.
Public speakers strongly supported the project; some opposed selling parkland.
Hub provides accessible health, wellness, and community supports for priority populations.
